title: Bellsprout Looks Fragile. Its Mouth Melts Iron.
premise: Bellsprout's skinny body looks harmless, but its mouth spits fluid that melts even iron.
audiencePromise: Contrast Bellsprout's tiny frame with its shocking corrosive power, then reveal its unusual weakness.
openLoop: How can something this skinny melt iron?
payoff: Bellsprout is tiny and flexible, yet its mouth spits corrosive fluid that melts iron.
engagementQuestion: Tiny body or iron-melting mouth—which shocks you more?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and conversational. Stress the contrast between fragile and dangerous. Pause briefly before the iron reveal.

scenes.headline: SKINNY FLOWER. IRON MELTER.
scenes.narration: This skinny flower can melt iron with its mouth.
scenes.caption: SMALL LOOKS. BIG THREAT.

scenes.headline: BARELY SEVEN-TENTHS TALL
scenes.narration: It's barely seven-tenths of a meter tall and weighs four kilos.
scenes.caption: TINY AND LIGHT

scenes.headline: IT BENDS AWAY
scenes.narration: Yet its thin, flexible body bends and sways away from attacks.
scenes.caption: THIN DOESN'T MEAN STIFF

scenes.headline: THE MOUTH IS THE WEAPON
scenes.narration: Then its mouth spits corrosive fluid that melts even iron.
scenes.caption: CORROSIVE FLUID → IRON

scenes.headline: ROOTED MEANS STUCK
scenes.narration: But when its roots are planted, it can't escape an enemy.
scenes.caption: POWERFUL, BUT NOT UNTOUCHABLE

scenes.headline: SMALL OR DANGEROUS?
scenes.narration: Tiny body or iron-melting mouth—which shocks you more?
scenes.caption: CHOOSE YOUR SURPRISE
